jd:
Who we are:

For over 25 years, Global Relay has set the standard in enterprise information archiving with industry-leading cloud archiving, surveillance, eDiscovery, and analytics solutions. We securely capture and preserve the communications data of the world’s most highly regulated firms, giving them greater visibility and control over their information and ensuring compliance with stringent regulations.

Though we offer competitive compensation and benefits and all the other perks one would expect from an established company, we are not your typical technology company. Global Relay is a career-building company. A place for big ideas. New challenges. Groundbreaking innovation. It’s a place where you can genuinely make an impact – and be recognized for it.

We believe great businesses thrive on diversity, inclusion, and the contributions of all employees. To that end, we recruit candidates from different backgrounds and foster a work environment that encourages employees to collaborate and learn from each other, completely free of barriers.

Your role:

As a DevOps engineer you will be responsible for the reliability and smooth operation of production and test environments and build automation to improve reliability and efficiency of code delivery from build to production.

At Global Relay we use leading edge technologies to deploy and manage thousands of servers and the infrastructure that delivers highly scalable and available services. The role involves cross-team collaboration and communication; you will be working closely with key stakeholders to ensure that product requirements are met. This is an opportunity to influence the design and implementation of systems at scales that many do not get a chance to work at.

Your responsibilities:

Depending on your team's needs and your skill-sets, your time will be split between



- Automation: Developing tools & frameworks to enhance our CI (Continuous Integration) & CD (Continuous Delivery) automation using industry standard CI/CD practices
- Operations: Monitor and ensure smooth operation of production and test environments by executing common sysadmin (system administration) tasks and automating repetitive tasks
- Service Reliability: Occasionally provide support and initial troubleshooting when required by reviewing dashboards and logs to ensure system issues are timely addressed

About you:



- Recent or soon-to-be graduate from a Computer Science or related field with Co-op experience
- Understanding of software systems concepts such as networking, firewalls, protocols, and databases
- Understanding of software delivery practices such as Git branching models and configuration management
- Experience with:

- Linux system administration
- Automation using Bash, Python or other similar scripting languages
- Experience with the following would be considered an asset:

- Puppet, Ansible, or Fabric
- CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or Bamboo
- Build systems such as Maven and Gradle
- Java development
To Apply: 

Think you’re a great fit for this job? Apply on our Global Relay Careers page with your cover letter, resume, and university transcripts in one PDF document. No emails or phone calls please; candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada.

Compensation:Global Relay advertises the pay range for this role in accordance with provincial law. Salaries are displayed in the form of annual base salary but are paid out semi-monthly for the duration of employment.

Salary range (monthly): $36,000 CAD - $56,000 CAD

What you can expect:

At Global Relay, there’s no ceiling to what you can achieve. It’s the land of opportunity for the energetic, the intelligent, the driven. You’ll receive the mentoring, coaching, and support you need to reach your career goals. You’ll be part of a culture that breeds creativity and rewards perseverance and hard work. And you’ll be working alongside smart, talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with complementary knowledge and skills.

Global Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We seek to ensure reasonable adjustments, accommodations, and personal time are tailored to meet the unique needs of every individual.

To learn more about our business, culture, and community involvement, visit www.globalrelay.com.
fit_why: Core job is Linux sysadmin and DevOps tooling; candidate lacks Linux admin experience

Job Description

AI IMPLEMENTATION INTERN

Short Description: We currently have an opening as an AI Implementation Intern who will report to the Business Intelligence Administrator.

Position Supervises: None

Position Structure: Temporary Internship (target November 2026 to May 2027, starting upon offer acceptance) / Full Time, 40 hours per week / Hourly / In Office.

What Apache Industrial Has To Offer

Apache Industrial offers career opportunities for both Craft and Non-Craft employees. Whether you work in the field or support our operations from the office, you’ll be part of a team that values safety, teamwork, and quality.

We provide opportunities to gain experience, grow, and advance your career while working alongside experienced and supportive teammates. At Apache Industrial, every role plays an important part in our success.

 POSITION OVERVIEW: As an AI Implementation Intern at Apache, you will be responsible for working with executive and operational leaders to understand what they need, then collaborating with the Business Intelligence team to build in-house systems and tools that meet those needs. The work uses large language models (LLMs), cloud services and company data to turn a leader's problem into a working tool.

a Typical Day Might Include



- Meeting with executive and operational leaders to understand their needs and the problems they want solved
- Working with the Business Intelligence team to design and build in-house systems and tools that meet those needs
- Writing and testing prompts for LLMs and building AI tools that automate routine tasks
- Managing code in GitHub and supporting cloud deployment of tools and databases
- Collaborating with team members, leaders, and other departments
- Managing priorities and completing tasks in a timely manner
- Supporting a professional, safe, and productive work environment

Required

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:



- Pursuing or holding a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
- Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs) and prompt engineering
- Experience with GitHub and version control (tracking changes to code)
- Experience with cloud deployment and cloud databases

Preferred



- Experience with SQL and Python
- Experience with Power BI or another reporting and analytics tool
- A portfolio of software or AI projects, for example a GitHub profile, that shows tools you have built

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities



- Basic data and analytics knowledge, including working with tables, spreadsheets and databases
- Clear communication with non-technical leaders, explaining technical work in plain language
- Ability to turn a leader's description of a problem into clear requirements for a tool
- Sound judgment in handling confidential company information
- Strong communication and organizational skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines

Physical Demands & Working Conditions



- Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation
-  Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, reach, and use hands as required for the position
- Ability to work primarily in an office or professional work environment
- May be required to work extended hours, weekends, or travel based on business needs
- Regular use of computers, phones, and other standard office equipment

Apache Industrial Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance, please contact the Human Resources Department.

jd:
T-Mobile is synonymous with innovation–and you could be part of the team that disrupted an entire industry! We reinvented customer service, brought real 5G to the nation, and now we’re shaping the future of technology in wireless and beyond. Our work is as exciting as it is rewarding, so consider the career opportunity below as your invitation to grow with us, make big things happen with us, above all, #BEYOU with us. Together, we won’t stop!
 
 Get hands-on experience, training—and a leg up on a bright future.

T-Mobile didn’t become a leader by following the playbook. We got here by breaking it. We’re a disruptor that now plays on a higher tier, and we’re still raising the bar for millions of customers nationwide. If you want to work somewhere that sets the standard instead of matching it, this is your place.

This is an 11-week paid learning experience where you’ll do real work, not busywork. You’ll build relationships with other interns and leaders across the company, and you’ll be paired with mentors who will challenge you to grow skills that matter. We’ll give you hands-on projects with real stakes, and we expect your creativity and sharp ideas to make an immediate impact. You’ll work alongside T-Mobile employees who have your back and who still believe the best ideas can come from anyone. 
 
 What It’s Like 
 You’ll join T-Ads, the Ad Tech team at T-Mobile. We’re a small, tight-knit group of engineers, mostly in our Philadelphia office, with teammates in NYC, Amsterdam, Texas, and other remote locations. We’re small enough that you’ll be seen and heard, and big enough that your work matters. Our culture is collaborative and low-ego: people help each other, code reviews are part of everyday life.

 What You’ll Do 
 You’ll work on the platform behind Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) advertising. It’s the software that plans, buys, delivers, and measures campaigns on billboards, Times Square displays, and bus-stop screens. It runs on an always-on, real-time bidding system, so you’ll work on a high-scale product with real users. You’ll own a project from start to finish, building something new or improving something that already exists. Depending on team needs and your interests, that could be the real-time bidstream, backend services, dynamic creative, or the web tools our teams and customers use.

 Key Responsibilities 
 
• Write, review, and test production-ready code as part of a team of engineers 
• Plan and break down a project from start to finish with your mentor, Product, Design, and QA 
• Learn the tech stack and the systems that support your project, and ask questions early and often 
• Give and receive feedback through code reviews from day one 
• Ship real code to production, with the chance to launch your project 
• Demo your project to the broader engineering org at the end of the internship 
 What It Takes 
 
• Experience with at least one language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, or Scala) and Git 
• Built something real: a team project, hackathon, internship, or open-source work 
• Familiarity with web, backend, or testing concepts (React, REST APIs, SQL) is a plus 
• Curious and collaborative, willing to question assumptions, and comfortable with code reviews 
• Moves with urgency, learns fast, and speaks up with ideas 
 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 
• At least 18 years of age 
• Legally authorized to work in the United States now and in the future 
• Must have one or more course(s) remaining in a Bachelors or Graduate degree program post internship 
• Employees of T-Mobile or Metro by T-Mobile are ineligible for external Summer Internships, please see Magenta Accelerator if interested 
 Relocation assistance will be provided to program participants who reside more than 50 miles from the internship location.

 Intern wages range from $27/hour to $50/hour. The successful candidate’s actual pay will be based on education/STEM vs non-STEM designation.

Never stop growing!   
As part of the T-Mobile team, you know the Un-carrier doesn’t have a corporate ladder–it’s more like a jungle gym of possibilities! We love helping our employees grow in their careers, because it’s that shared drive to aim high that drives our business and our culture forward. By applying for this career opportunity, you’re living our values while investing in your career growth–and we applaud it. You’re unstoppable!   
T-Mobile USA, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All decisions concerning the employment relationship will be made without regard to age, race, ethnicity, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, national origin, religious affiliation, marital status, citizenship status, veteran status, the presence of any physical or mental disability, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Discrimination, retaliation or harassment based upon any of these factors is wholly inconsistent with how we do business and will not be tolerated.   
Talent comes in all forms at the Un-carrier. If you are an individual with a disability and need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know by emailing ApplicantAccommodation@t-mobile.com or calling 1-844-873-9500.
